sql: WITH t AS (SELECT DISTINCT market_ticker FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1'), p AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, quantity, captured_at FROM positions JOIN t USING (market_ticker) ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC) SELECT 'POS' k, market_ticker, quantity::text q, captured_at::text t FROM p WHERE quantity<>0 UNION ALL SELECT 'ORD', market_ticker, side||' '||limit_price||'c x'||quantity, created_at::text FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1' AND status IN ('resting','submitted','pending','unknown') ORDER BY 1,2
